The industry quietly changed its priorities. After years of megapixel wars, phone makers are now competing on computational processing and sensor size instead.

articles.title: The Moto Z Play has the best battery life
articles.subtitle: Two days on a single charge, easily
articles.excerpt: Apple Watch review: Design. For a slightly more opinionated version of the video review above, here's the male half of the team...
articles.author: ashraf

content.text: While flagship phones chase thinner bodies, the Moto Z Play goes the other way — a bigger battery in a slightly thicker shell, and the runtime shows it.
In our mixed-use test cycle, the phone comfortably lasted a full two days before needing a charge, well ahead of most competitors in its class.

articles.title: LG V20 review: lots of features, less refinement
articles.subtitle: A spec sheet that outshines the experience
articles.excerpt: Apple Watch review: Design. For a slightly more opinionated version of the video review above, here's the male half of the team...
articles.author: ashraf

content.text: The V20 packs a secondary display, a removable battery and a genuinely excellent DAC for audio — on paper, a spec-sheet darling.
In daily use, though, the software doesn't always keep pace with the hardware ambition, and the secondary screen feels underused.
